title: Gumball Hover Uses Direction Colors
description: When hovering over the gumball, all elements are shown with highlighted secondary color. Make sure the highlighting happens in the color of the direction (X/Y/Z axis colors) instead of the global secondary hover token.
summary:
Gumball hover/active highlighting now keeps each handle's direction color (X/Y/Z accents) instead of swapping to the global secondary hover token.

Root cause: `gumballResolveHandleVisual` and `GumballInteractionPreview` replaced `baseColor` with `--color-changed-hovered` / `--color-changed-selected` (mapped to accent-secondary / accent), so every hovered handle turned teal.

Fix: keep `baseColor` on hover/active and only raise opacity; previews use `gumballBaseColorForKind`. Removed unused `hover`/`active` color fields from `GumballVisualPalette`. Updated UnifiedGumball math expectations.

Verified: `nx test @semio-tech/ui-react -- -t "UnifiedGumball math"` passed.
